quoted.T1:13:0: "Quiet my head, I suppose. … So I want one problem that's just soil and weather. That nobody can email me about. … A problem with no one attached to it."
quoted.T1:35:0: "But if I can't even do this … then maybe it wasn't a blip. Maybe that's just what I'm like now. Maybe I'm someone who breaks."
quoted.T1:19:0: "Which was either kind or a threat, I genuinely couldn't tell. … I read everything as an evaluation. Everyone's a performance review."
